{{Youmay|the type of Imperial power plant|the [[ILH-KK Citadel-class civilian cruiser|ILH-KK ''Citadel''-class civilian cruiser]], or other uses of the term "[[Citadel (disambiguation)|Citadel]]"|linebreak=1}}
The '''Citadel class''' was a type of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] power plant. These were considered to be the most powerful of the power plants. Another type was known as the [[Fortress class]].
